question: Who among the following is the author of the book titled ‘Selection Day’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Aravind Adiga**__

__
 
• **Selection Day** is a sports fiction novel written by Booker Prize winner Aravind Adiga in 2016.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aravind Adiga**

 
 
• **Aravind Adiga** is a journalist and writer from India.
 
• His debut novel, The White Tiger, was published in 2008 and won the 2008 Man Booker Prize for Fiction.
 
• It was one of four writers shortlisted for the 2017** DSC Prize for South Asian Literature.**
 
• It follows Mohan Kumar, a **chutney vendor who coaches his two boys,** Manju Kumar and Radha Krishna, for Mumbai's under-19 cricket squad.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Nissim Ezekiel** was a** poet, actor, dramatist, editor, and art critic of Indian Jewish origin**.
 
• He was a pivotal player in the literary history of postcolonial India, particularly for Indian Poetry in English.
